TITLE: DEEP END
SHELL_MATERIAL_COLOR: Translucent swimming-pool cyan plastic with a slightly cloudy, milky core and a few lime-green molded accent pieces. Simple soft reflections, faint visible internal support ribs, and a playful early-2000s toy-like finish.
SHAPE_LANGUAGE: A wide, chunky rectangular cartridge with rounded stepped shoulders, a gently arched top edge like an indoor pool roof, and a broad recessed front label. The lower connector housing is a simple original rectangular notch. Keep it one solid, usable-looking cartridge, fully visible in the frame.
MOTIFS_GROOVES_SURFACE_DETAILS: Two shallow parallel wave grooves wrap around the bottom of the shell. Three short lime-green grip ribs on each upper shoulder suggest waterslide lanes. Tiny square tile-like dimples are molded beside the label, with a small unlettered crescent recess near the top. All details belong to the plastic shell; no separate decorative objects.
OBJECT_MOOD: Cool, inviting, nostalgic, and quietly uncanny; a forgotten aquatic-centre game you remember playing late at night. A pale blue studio gradient keeps the luminous cyan shell readable.
LABEL_SCENE_DESCRIPTION: An empty indoor aquatic centre beneath a dark glass ceiling and bright moonlight. Luminous turquoise pool water is the focal point, with thin low mist, lime-green waterslides disappearing into shadow, white and light-blue tiled decks, simple palm trees, and plastic lounge chairs. A tiny distant EXIT sign hangs without a doorway beneath it. Use soft bloom, deliberately fake water reflections, and low-resolution early-2000s game textures. The large exact title DEEP END sits in a clear upper area in simple pale aqua lettering with a restrained lime edge, leaving the glowing pool and slides readable.
